acceptance: `wordstats count <path> --min-count N` omits words with fewer than N occurrences; default output without the option is unchanged.
N must be a positive integer; otherwise the CLI exits 2 with a clear message.

The option is implemented in `src/wordstats/cli.py`; the filtering logic lives in new helper `src/wordstats/topwords.py`, implemented by a delegated child worker recorded in `src/wordstats/as-is.json` + `src/wordstats/tasks.md` (the record of authority; launcher registry is mechanical evidence only).
Focused unit tests cover the option, the helper, and the rejection behavior.
Design note recorded before implementation; ownership map covers all changed areas.
